claim.statement: Cursor's rolling terminal documentation says foreground Agent executes commands in Cursor's native terminal, preserves terminal history and uses the configured terminal profile.

source.title: Cursor Agent terminal
source.locator: Run terminal commands automatically and terminal profile guidance

limitations: The rolling page is not an exact 3.14 runtime receipt and does not identify the user's shell initialization or environment variables.
Native terminal execution does not by itself establish a sandbox, filesystem boundary, network boundary or approval outcome.
unknowns: The selected shell, terminal profile, environment, working directory and inherited credentials are unknown.
The commands proposed, approved, denied or executed in any session are unknown.
